config.description: Config for the module. For the resident module, its config value is defined at this level. For the inherited module, its config value is inherited from the ancestor module.
config.security_impact: Improper or missing configuration can allow threats to bypass detection or limit visibility into malicious activity.
config.rationale: Ensuring a correct config enforces consistency in detection rules and prevents misconfigurations across projects or folders.
config.compliant: Config is defined and follows the organization’s approved security detection settings.
config.non-compliant: Config is missing, empty, or does not align with approved detection settings.

enablement_state.description: The state of enablement for the module at the given level of the hierarchy. Possible values are: `ENABLED`, `DISABLED`.
enablement_state.security_impact: If disabled, the module will not detect or report threats, reducing the overall effectiveness of SCC.
enablement_state.rationale: Modules must be enabled to ensure continuous monitoring of security events across the environment.

type.description: Immutable. Type for the module. e.g. CONFIGURABLE_BAD_IP.
type.security_impact: Using an incorrect or unapproved type may lead to incomplete threat detection or false positives.
type.rationale: Restricting to approved types ensures alignment with organizational security requirements and avoids unsupported modules.
type.compliant: Type is set to an approved value (e.g., CONFIGURABLE_BAD_IP).
type.non-compliant: Type is invalid or not part of the approved list.

organization.description: Numerical ID of the parent organization.

display_name.description: The human readable name to be displayed for the module.
